title: Equitable Restless Multi-Armed Bandits: A General Framework Inspired By Digital Health
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and equity in resource allocation within the Restless Multi-Armed Bandit framework, particularly for digital health applications. While it evaluates its approach using social welfare objectives like 'maximin reward' (egalitarianism) and 'max Nash welfare,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics in the context of human values or belief systems as typically studied in NLP or AI ethics benchmarking.
